item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 04/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An area of low pressure over Guangdong will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China in the next couple of days. With the area of low pressure departing, showers will lessen over Guangdong on Sunday and Monday. Another area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the South China Sea early to midweek next week. It may develop into a tropical cyclone, but there are uncertainties in its track and intensity.

Date/Month: 05/08 (Friday)
Wind: South force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
